title: Document the "refusals explain themselves" design rule in Engram's docs
outcome: Document the "refusals explain themselves" design rule in Engram's docs
acceptance: Engram's docs (docs/agent-pair-workflow.md or the architecture or contributing guidance; not AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md) state the agreed rule: a refusal reports the deciding check, the concrete reason with observed values, and the corrective action when one exists; REFUSED, PENDING and UNKNOWN stay distinct; silent skips and discarded errors are defects; remote refusals travel back to the requester. No new gate is added
